title: Tool-Augmented Agent vs LLM-Only Baseline: Fault-Injected Topology Evaluation (Preregistered)
research_question: Does augmenting an LLM with a deterministic network verifier and a topology-aware lightweight simulator (tool-augmented agent) increase verifier-pass rates and reduce simulated outage-inducing misconfigurations versus an LLM-only single-shot generator under injected faults and adversarially ambiguous intents?
confirmatory_hypotheses: H1 (primary): The tool-augmented agent yields a higher verifier-pass rate (binary: pass/fail) than the LLM-only pipeline on matched tasks; estimand = paired_success_rate_difference_guarded_minus_baseline (agent − baseline).

H2: The tool-augmented agent yields a lower simulated outage incidence (binary: any destination-pair reachability loss under injected faults) than the LLM-only pipeline (reported as a secondary estimand, exploratory for formal testing).
H3: Relative improvement (verifier-pass rate delta) is larger on complex multi-statement intents than on simple single-statement intents (pre-registered subgroup analysis).
exploratory_questions: E1: Which repair iteration counts dominate improvement (iter=1 vs iter>=2) in the full-agent pipeline?
E2: Typical repair trace patterns and common failure modes (semantic mismatch, parser errors, verifier false-negatives).
E3: Cost trade-offs (model calls, wall-clock latency) required to achieve verifier-pass improvements.
benchmark_scope: Public synthetic topology pool (deterministic synthetic topology templates and vendor-agnostic CLI fragments).
Injected fault scenarios (link failures, route flap events) executed only in the lightweight topology simulator described in execution artifacts.
primary_estimand: paired_success_rate_difference_guarded_minus_baseline on deterministic-verifier pass indicator (agent − baseline); computed by paired_binary_analysis_v1 executor.
secondary_estimands: paired_success_rate_difference_guarded_minus_baseline on simulated outage indicator (agent − baseline) — reported with 95% CI, exploratory.
median model-call count difference (agent − baseline) and median wall-clock latency difference (agent − baseline) — descriptive cost trade-offs.
sampling_plan: Confirmatory sample: 300 paired intent tasks (paired within-task comparison). Strata: 150 simple single-statement intents, 150 complex multi-statement intents. Inclusion: deterministic selection from the synthetic topology/template pool. Exclusion: exact-string matches to curated public-config corpus (auto-detected) will be removed from confirmatory set and moved to exploratory; token-similarity >0.95 flagged for exploratory treatment. Confirmatory_items=300.
power_and_precision_plan: Primary estimand: paired_success_rate_difference_guarded_minus_baseline. Target minimally important effect: 0.20 absolute increase in verifier-pass rate. Assumptions: baseline pass ~0.60, two-sided alpha=0.05, power=0.90, conservative discordant-pair fraction=0.30. With n=300 paired tasks, powered to detect ~0.20 absolute paired-success difference with >90% power. Sensitivity analyses: recompute under discordant fractions 0.20 and 0.40 and report observed 95% CI for paired difference.
exclusion_rules: Exclude tasks that are exact-string matches to entries in the curated public-config corpus (moved to exploratory).
Exclude any task whose generated or transformed config fails deterministic parse-tree round-trip canonicalization (reported and moved to exploratory).
missingness_plan: Technical failures (API errors, tool crashes) are logged with provider error codes/timestamps/hashes. Primary analysis: complete-pair handling (exclude pairs missing both binary outcomes). Sensitivity analysis treats failed model calls as verifier-fail (complete_pair_primary_with_failure_as_zero_sensitivity). All exclusions and counts reported with reasons and artifact hashes.
analysis_plan: Primary analysis: paired_binary_analysis_v1 executor computing paired_success_rate_difference_guarded_minus_baseline on deterministic-verifier pass indicator, alpha=0.05 two-sided. Primary failed_call_treatment: complete_pair_primary (exclude pairs lacking valid binary outcomes). Sensitivity: treat failed runs as verifier-fail. Secondary analyses: paired binary estimator on simulated outage indicator (exploratory) with 95% CI. Cost comparisons (model-call count, latency) via Wilcoxon signed-rank and descriptive medians/IQR. Subgroup (simple vs complex) via Cochran–Mantel–Haenszel (exploratory). All analysis executor parameters frozen and recorded in execution manifest.
multiplicity_plan: Single pre-registered primary endpoint (verifier-pass difference). Secondary and subgroup analyses labeled exploratory and interpreted without multiplicity correction. Sensitivity analyses pre-registered and reported transparently.
contamination_plan: Benchmarks: synthetic-topo-300. Risk factors: verbatim task overlap with public corpora, template leakage, simulator/verifier mis-specification. Detection: exact-string matching vs curated public-config corpus; token-level similarity thresholding to flag near-verbatim matches; unit tests comparing verifier outputs on seeded canonical cases. Flagging rules: exact matches -> exclude from confirmatory; token-similarity >0.95 -> exploratory-only. Analysis: flagged items excluded from confirmatory analysis and analyzed separately; all flags, detection outputs, and hashes recorded. Residual uncertainty: semantic overlap below thresholds and vendor training-data characteristics may remain.
stopping_rule: Stop when all 300 paired tasks have produced valid binary outcomes for both pipelines (complete-pair) or when maximum model-call budget for the adapter contract is exhausted (maximum_model_calls = 600), or upon reaching the wall-clock limit of 7 days; technical restarts allowed only per frozen retry policy and recorded.
planned_outputs: IEEE-formatted five-page short paper (CNSM Agentic AI Researcher track) including Disclosure Statement
Experiment code, deterministic seeds, transformation artifacts, verifier/simulator unit tests
Raw model responses and artifact hashes
Analysis artifacts: paired_binary_analysis_v1 outputs, CIs, nonparametric tests
